entries.heading: For funds provided to the Department of Veterans Affairs
ancestors: DIVISION J—MILITARY CONSTRUCTION, VETERANS AFFAIRS, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2018
entries.text:
Sec. 250.  For funds provided to the Department of Veterans Affairs 
for each of fiscal year 2018 and 2019, section 258 of Division A of 
Public Law 114-223 shall apply.
